newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gentex estimates lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gentex estimates lowered.

text.p: -- Mesirow Financial said Thursday it is reducing its fourth-quarter earnings estimate for Gentex Corp by $0.01 per share to $0.21.
-- Analyst Greg Salchow said the move reflects lost production from a strike against General Motors Corp by Canadian workers and local strikes in the United States.
-- Mesirow's estimate for fiscal 1996 was also lowered to $0.69 from $0.70, said Salchow, although the company's estimate for 1997 remains unchanged at $1 per share.
-- Gentex makes automotive parts and accessories. Its stock was down 1/8 at 20-1/4.
